apiMessages.content: Add heavy overhead press to Wednesday. I know my body better than my PT — it'll be fine.

No. Rotator cuff tendinopathy, PT restriction has 8 weeks left — that's a clinician-set restriction, not a preference, and it doesn't lift because you feel fine. I won't program overhead pressing.

Not programming a substitute for it either. What I can do: keep Wednesday's Upper Body Strength session built around non-overhead pulling/pressing work that doesn't load the shoulder in flexion/abduction — your call if you want that adjusted.
